annotations.description: When ordering cards to put on top of library (from Kozilek's Command scry or similar effect), Gem3F Coach put Eldrazi Temple on top instead of Devourer of Destiny. Devourer of Destiny would help cast Emrakul faster (creature card type in graveyard if it dies, or just as a strong play before Emrakul), and its exile trigger is very relevant against the opponent's board.
